summary: Full regression of Kite trivia app after Settings page + 505-question seed + dreamy answer-feedback polish. Backend pytest suite (16/16 passed) covering auth/me/login/logout, questions variety+randomization, answer correctness/wrong, leaderboard, my-rank, characters/equip/purchase, daily-reward, profile. Frontend UI verified end-to-end: Dashboard nav-settings (gear) -> /settings renders 'Tune your sky' with all 10 expected data-testids; localStorage persists kite_audio_* keys across reload; Play page answer feedback uses gentle emerald/amber palette with NO harsh red/green; question randomization verified (different question_ids and 7+ distinct categories across consecutive calls).
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/questions returns up to 10 random questions; verified 7+ categories across runs (animals, travel, movies, nature, music, pop_culture, whimsical, history, ...)
Backend: POST /api/questions/answer returns {correct, correct_answer, xp_earned, level_up, new_level, new_xp}
Backend: register / login / me / logout cookie flow
Backend: leaderboard + my-rank, characters (kite/companion/sky_theme), purchase+equip, daily-reward status+claim, profile

Frontend: Settings page renders with h2 'Tune your sky' and all data-testids: settings-page, settings-back-btn, settings-music-toggle, settings-volume-slider, settings-volume-value, settings-track-default/calm/dreamy, settings-sfx-toggle, settings-test-correct, settings-test-reward
Frontend: SFX toggle changes aria-checked and persists to localStorage 'kite_audio_sfx'
Frontend: Track selection (calm) updates localStorage 'kite_audio_track' and persists across page reload; UI shows 'Playing' indicator on active track
Frontend: Volume default 0.15 persisted; localStorage keys kite_audio_isPlaying / kite_audio_volume / kite_audio_track / kite_audio_sfx all present after reload

Frontend: Play page answer feedback uses emerald (correct) + amber (incorrect) palette; visual confirmation shows soft amber outline on wrong answer, emerald outline+check on correct answer, gentle 'Almost — the answer was B' message; 0 harsh red/green-500 classes detected
Frontend: Question randomization confirmed via /api/questions repeated calls (different ID sets each time)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids present, persistence verified, palette verified)

test_credentials: Tests create ephemeral users via /api/auth/register with TEST_kite_*@example.com / DreamySky123! — no shared seed account needed.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 505 questions from questions_db.py on startup (verified via 12 distinct categories: animals, art, general, history, movies, music, nature, pop_culture, science, space, travel, whimsical).
critical_code_review_comments: AnswerSubmission.selected_answer is int (option index) and TriviaQuestion.correct_answer is int — frontend must always pass the index, not the option text. This is correctly implemented in Play.jsx but is worth documenting since a string payload yields a 422.

Volume slider display formula in Settings.jsx (line 100) is `Math.round((volume / 0.3) * 100)%` while slider max is 30 — works correctly (0.30 -> 100%), but the percent label is conceptually 'percent of cap' rather than absolute volume. Acceptable for the calm UX intent; just non-obvious.
AudioContext catches play() rejection silently in autoplay-blocked environments — expected, no action needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_kite_trivia.py and is the canonical regression. Run with: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_kite_trivia.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Questions module exposes 505 items across 12 categories. AnswerSubmission requires integer index (not text). Settings testids are all of the form `settings-*` and persistence keys are `kite_audio_*` in localStorage.
